items.title: Huskies Set Sights on San José State
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University football team closes out back-to-back road games this weekend, making a trip to San José State on Saturday, Nov. 7 at 3 p.m. CT. Saturday's conference game between the Huskies and Spartans will be broadcasted on MW+ and NBC Sports Bay Area. The radio broadcast on 94-9 WDKB begins at 2:30 p.m. CT.

items.title: This Week In Huskie Athletics – Nov. 3, 2026
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University men's soccer team can clinch the Horizon League regular season championship today as men's and women's basketball, football, volleyball and wrestling all go on the road this weekend.

items.title: Huskies barely come up short against Rebels on Halloween

items.title: Huskies Take UNLV To The Wire, Fall 31-24
items.summary: LAS VEGAS, Nev. – The Northern Illinois University football team put up 493 yards of total offense Saturday night but could not pull even with the UNLV Rebels in a 31-24 loss at Allegiant Stadium Saturday night.

items.summary: On Halloween night, NIU football (0-7, 0-3 MW) will take a trip to Allegiant Stadium to take on the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (4-3, 2-1 MW). items.title: NIU Heads West for UNLV on Halloween Night
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University football team begins the first game of back-to-back road trips this weekend, heading to UNLV on Saturday night. The Huskies and Rebels will get underway on Halloween at 9:30 p.m. CT. Jordan Kent, Doug Pederson and Jaclyn DeAugustino will call the game for CBS Sports Network.

items.title: DeAree Rogers Named to Biletnikoff Award Watch List
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – Wide Receiver DeAree Rogers of the Northern Illinois University football team has been named to the Biletnikoff Award Watch List, the Tallahassee Quarterback Club (TQC) Foundation announced today. The Biletnikoff Award annually recognizes the college football season's outstanding FBS receiver.

items.title: This Week In Huskie Athletics – October 26, 2026
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – As NIU's fall starts approach the finish line of the regular season, NIU men's and women's basketball teams begin the 2026-27 campaign in earnest at the end of the week for This Week In Huskie Athletics.

items.title: Huskies Upended by Hawai’i
items.summary: DEKALB, Ill. – Tied at 14 in the second quarter, Hawai'i scored 35 consecutive points as the Rainbow Warriors claimed a 56-21 victory over the Northern Illinois University Huskies on Saturday afternoon (Oct. 24) at Huskie Stadium.

items.title: Huskies Host Hawai’i on Hall of Fame Weekend
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University football team returns home this weekend to face Hawai'i on Saturday, Oct. 24 at 2:30 p.m. CT on Hall of Fame Weekend, presented by eo5 Hotels. Matt Rodewald and Clay Harbor will be on the call for the broadcast on MW+.

items.title: Jordan Lynch Jersey Retirement Set for Saturday
items.summary: DEKALB, Ill. – Northern Illinois University Athletics will retire the jersey of 2013 Heisman Trophy Finalist and 2026 NFF College Football Hall of Fame Inductee Jordan Lynch this Saturday, Oct. 24, when the Huskies host Hawai'i. Lynch becomes the fifth player in NIU Football history to have his jersey retired, joining George Bork (1960-63), Bob Heimerdinger (1948-51), Mark Kellar (1971-73) and Dave Petzke (1977-78)

items.title: This Week In Huskie Athletics: October 19, 2026
items.summary: DeKALB, IL – The Northern Illinois University men's soccer team hosts Cleveland State in a key match atop the Horizon League standings on Sunday afternoon and NIU Athletics will induct six new members into the Hall of Fame on Friday in This Week In Huskie Athletics.
